newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil tax receipts 8.442 bln reais in January.
newsitem.headline: Brazil tax receipts 8.442 bln reais in January.

text.p: Brazil's federal tax receipts in January totalled 8.442 billion reais, the highest ever level recorded for the month, the National Tax Secertariat said.
The figure represented a nominal increase of 19.24 percent over January of last year, or 9.94 percent if inflation during the period was taken into account, the secretariat said in statement.
In December, tax receipts were 10.304 billion reais.
The tax office said January's revenue was an all-time record for the month.
